basic_table.title: Floor Area Regulations for R1 Through R5 Districts

rows.footnote: For standard zoning lots of 4,000 sf or more, residential floor area associated with any single dwelling unit may not exceed an equivalent FAR of 0.60.

predominantly_built_up.qualification: Only for qualifying lots utilizing Section 23-71; R4/R5 without a suffix. Full Section 23-711 eligibility must be checked; do not assume eligibility.

limits: Residential FAR only. Verify district, qualifying residential site definition, project date, special districts, overlays, use-specific rules and other applicable modifications. This table alone does not establish parcel eligibility or overall compliance.
